newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen injecting reserves via overnight RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen injecting reserves via overnight RPs.

text.p: Economists expected the Federal Reserve to inject reserves in the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday.

"Since Monday's three-day system repo was not fixed (dealers are allowed to withdraw their collateral), the Fed may have to execute an overnight system repo today. However, if funds are trading below the targeted 5-1/4 percent, the Fed could stay on the sidelines," said Kathy Bostjancic, money market analyst at UBS Securities Inc.

Economists at MMS International saw the Fed with a large add need through the rest of the week due to month-end pressures and expected a round of overnight system RPs during the Fed's usual midmorning period.
Fed funds opened at 5-1/2 percent and were last trading at 5-9/16 percent, well above the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury desk 212-859-1663))
